reason: The README describes an MCP bridge that lets AI agents automate Cheat Engine for process memory inspection, reverse engineering, debugging, process control, memory modification, DLL injection, and code execution; its primary user-facing purpose is automation, with R2 capabilities requiring human review.

summaries.zh: 通过 MCP 将 AI 智能体连接到 Cheat Engine，以自动执行进程内存分析、指针扫描、调试和逆向工程操作。
summaries.en: Connects AI agents to Cheat Engine through MCP to automate process memory analysis, pointer scanning, debugging, and reverse-engineering tasks.

capabilities: Read and scan target process memory
Follow pointer chains and analyze structures
Disassemble and analyze functions
Set hardware breakpoints and use DBVM tracing
Enumerate, attach to, launch, pause, and resume processes
Allocate memory and change target memory protection
Inject DLLs and execute shellcode or remote methods
Send window messages and simulate keyboard input
Optionally execute shell commands when explicitly enabled
